evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live custom-interface registry.
The screen contains the exact title 'Official SpawnPK Knowledgebase' plus exact 'Category List' and 'Selected Article Title Text' placeholders.

The class owns 'Go back', 'Select option', WIKI_SELECTED_ state, category/description population helpers and overflow guards, fixing it as the Knowledgebase browser rather than a generic article panel.
The builder uses exact 'wiki/sprite 0' presentation assets and article/category list surfaces.
The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live custom-interface registry.
The screen contains exact title '<img=128> SpawnPK World Tournaments <img=128>' and default next-tournament text 'Next world tournament: @yel@Dharok PK Tournament'.
Exact controls include 'Enter Tournament <img=51>', 'Spectate Tournament', 'View tournament shop', previous tournament winners and tournament point shop.
The interface contains the exact tournament-prize area and historical-winner presentation, establishing the main World Tournament screen rather than the separate R445 leaderboard screen.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 main World Tournament screen; separate from R445 WorldTournamentLeaderboardsInterface.
